taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-15 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1132.2 | 7.42 | 7.42
2 | 3621.5 | 17.67 | 25.09
3 | 4447.9 | 1.70 | 26.79
4 | 4307.5 | 0.53 | 27.32
5 | 7664.9 | 4.92 | 32.24
6 | 12762.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AKHA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Site Note**

Station: T-15
Curve type: AKHA-type
Aquifer depth: 26.79 – 27.32 m
Recommendation: The relative resistivity dip at Layer 4 (4307.5 Ω·m) sandwiched between higher-resistivity layers is interpreted as a thin fractured/weathered zone within the resistive host rock and is the most probable water-bearing interval. Target drilling and screen placement across 26.79–27.32 m depth, with casing through the overlying 0–26.79 m sequence to seal off the non-productive high-resistivity layers.
